statement: The replacement live attribution calibration exists as a committed per-owner cost table under test/simulation/calibration/2026-09-17/, each figure citing its immutable artifact, produced by one fresh-container five-node formation on GCP under the repaired formation-attribution semantics (F: protocol task-tracker lineage, seed pipeline phase-completion lineage) on the same external scenario as the 2026-09-13 run: same machine class and documented machine factor, same formation verdict, same owner vocabulary, same formed-mark harvesting rule, same watchdog and profile evidence. Both the formed-window snapshot and the complete deadline window are recorded. The run counts only if the unattributed bucket is under 10 percent of the window. No 2026-09-13 number is a target, and no number from that lineage is edited.

constraints.statement: The 2026-09-13 lineage (seed-owner-costs.md, .evidence.json, .report.json and formation-seed-2026-09-13.json) keeps every number it has. Its supersession record may name its replacement; nothing else in it changes.

Owner durations, dispatch and handoff counts, turn segments, mean microseconds per segment, unattributed and idle are recomputed from the measured data of this run. No old number is a target and no arithmetic adjustment is admissible.

The table becomes the simulator's coefficient source only because live and simulator now share the repaired attribution semantics; the simulator is repointed at this lineage and the old lineage stays refused for correspondence.
